component.name: Nucleus
component.summary: A modular, floating control center for Linux

description.p: Nucleus brings everyday desktop tools into a single floating panel, one shortcut away. It is not a desktop environment or a system monitor replacement — it sits on top of your existing desktop and stays out of the way until you need it.

ul.li: Clipboard history, notes, todo, timer, stopwatch, pomodoro and quick links
Colour picker, for any colour on screen
CPU and memory, at a glance
Battery, including wireless mice and headsets
Network: connection type, throughput and addresses
Temperature for the processor and drives
Hardware: board, processor, graphics, memory, OS and kernel
Weather for a city you choose

description.p: Two cards behave differently inside a Flatpak sandbox: disk usage is not shown, because the container's mount table describes the container rather than the machine, and graphics temperature is unavailable on NVIDIA hardware, whose reading comes from a vendor tool the runtime does not carry.

screenshot.caption: The panel, with clipboard history, notes and at-a-glance CPU and memory
Disk space, current weather, and what the machine is made of
Settings: theme, and every card switched on or off individually
